To find when the seed reaches 36 feet, solve:
36 = -16t² + 80t

Rearranging:
16t² - 80t + 36 = 0
4t² - 20t + 9 = 0

Using the quadratic formula:
t = (20 ± √(400 - 144)) / 8
t = (20 ± √256) / 8
t = (20 ± 16) / 8

This gives t = 4.5 or t = 0.5

The first time it reaches 36 feet is **t = 0.5** seconds.
